rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows an aggregate extraction error. The extracted holdings fair value is 410.050595m, but the filing's March 31, 2026 debt-and-equity schedule total is 249.694433m, a 160.356162m overstatement. The filing also reports total investments of 572.771377m versus 680.173130m and total assets of 573.517m versus 680.830m, both declining about 15.8%; therefore the flagged 71.25 percentage-point growth divergence is not present in raw source. The excess cannot be localized to specific rows from the available disposition evidence, but the cross-period tables make a comparative-period leak the most likely mechanism.
